note: No public queryable parcel service found for Gentry County MO. The state's statewide all-parcels MapServer (gis.mo.gov FMDCrealEstate_allParcels) returns 'Token Required'; the state-owned parcels layer is not tax parcels. The Gentry assessor site and county links expose no GIS endpoint. Regrid (token-gated, commercial), Acres (browser viewer with no endpoint) and vendor shapefile sellers are not public services.
